changelog: Channel artwork now correctly uses a currently airing episode's series backdrop for the channel and programme background. Episode artwork remains available for posters and thumbnails, while the series image provides the intended contextual wide background.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
